The Board noted that at its meeting held on October 17, 2025, it had approved the incorporationof a Wholly Owned Subsidiary, namely Zastian FZ-LLC (or such other name as approved by theAuthority), in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, for manufacturing of FIBC Jumbo Bags, primarilyconsidering the then prevailing U.S. tariff structure and related commercial considerations.The Board further noted that subsequent removal of the relevant U.S. tariffs resulted in thebusiness rationale and commercial necessity for the proposed UAE entity no longer subsisting.Accordingly, the proposed incorporation of the UAE subsidiary was cancelled.
